parrafo_1.es: EZ Auto Protection empezó en 2015 como un camión de detailing móvil y hoy es un centro especializado en Hialeah, dirigido por Eloy. Trabajamos corrección de pintura, detailing completo y ceramic coating certificado, en autos desde sedanes familiares hasta deportivos de alta gama.
parrafo_1.en: EZ Auto Protection started in 2015 as a mobile detailing truck and today is a specialty facility in Hialeah, run by Eloy. We handle paint correction, full detailing and certified ceramic coating, on everything from family sedans to high end sports cars.

parrafo_2.es: Cada trabajo se hace a mano, con atención al detalle que se nota: 32 reseñas en Google, todas de 5 estrellas, respaldan el resultado.
parrafo_2.en: Every job is done by hand, with the kind of attention to detail that shows: 32 Google reviews, all five stars, back up the result.

texto.es: Nos llamas o escribes por Instagram y nos cuentas qué necesita tu auto. Respuesta directa, sin intermediarios.
texto.en: Call or message us on Instagram and tell us what your car needs. Direct answers, no middlemen.

texto.es: Revisamos el estado de la pintura y te damos el detalle del trabajo antes de empezar, sin sorpresas.
texto.en: We check the condition of the paint and walk you through the job before we start, no surprises.

texto.es: Corrección de pintura, limpieza y ceramic coating aplicados a mano, con el mismo cuidado en cada capa.
texto.en: Paint correction, cleaning and ceramic coating applied by hand, with the same care on every layer.

texto.es: Revisamos el resultado contigo antes de la entrega y te explicamos cómo mantenerlo brillando.
texto.en: We go over the result with you before handoff and explain how to keep it looking sharp.

nota.es: Cada trabajo se cotiza según el tamaño y el estado del auto. Llámanos y te damos el precio antes de empezar.
nota.en: Every job is quoted based on the size and condition of the car. Call us and we will give you the price before we start.

texto.es: Protección de pintura, rines e interior con un brillo que dura. El servicio por el que más nos buscan.
texto.en: Paint, wheel and interior protection with a shine that lasts. The service we get asked for the most.

texto.es: Rayones, marcas y hologramas pulidos a mano hasta devolverle la profundidad al color original.
texto.en: Scratches, swirl marks and holograms polished out by hand until the paint's original depth comes back.

texto.es: Lavado a fondo, tapicería e interior tratados con el mismo cuidado que la pintura.
texto.en: Deep wash, upholstery and interior treated with the same care as the paint.

texto.es: Ceramic coating en rines y tratamiento de cuero, para acabar el trabajo hasta el último detalle.
texto.en: Ceramic coating on wheels and leather treatment, to finish the job down to the last detail.

pie.es: ¿No ves lo que buscas? Llámanos, seguro lo hacemos.
pie.en: Don't see what you are looking for? Call us, we probably do it.

items.quote: Hands down the best service, paint correction, detail, ceramic coat etc I have ever gotten. Eloy took my 2017 BMW M3 and made that car look better than I got it from the showroom floor. Between the exterior paint correction, exterior ceramic coat, interior cleaning, interior ceramic coat, wheel cleaning and wheel ceramic coat to the customer service. Eloy made it all simple, comfortable and easy transaction! Thank you EZ Detailing!

I brought my 2017 C7 Corvette Stingray fresh from the dealership straight to EZ Detailing for a ceramic coating & I could not be happier with the results, not to mention the customer service is unbeatable. The ceramic coating not only makes my car glisten (rain or shine) but also makes washing so much more enjoyable. The results speak for themselves! I would not leave my car in anyone elses hands.

The best detailing shop in Florida. The owner (Eloy) is such a humble guy. Easy to talk to. I've gone there for the past 2 years now, getting the sealant done which protects your paint for 6 months (I'm 9 months in and my car still looks like glass). He ceramic coated the wheels and the outcome is just incredible. HIGHLY RECOMMEND!

I've had such an incredible experience with Eloy. He is extremely professional and listens to his customers. With the unfortunate circumstance of cement spilled on my vehicle, Eloy and his team did a remarkable job of bringing my car back to life. Truly thankful to have stumbled upon his shop just minutes from my job.
